title: Battle of Komaki and Nagakute
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Komaki and Nagakute", at revision 1381491739, opens: "The Battle of Komaki and Nagakute , also known as the Komaki Campaign, was a series of battles in 1584 between the forces of Hashiba Hideyoshi and the forces of Oda Nobukatsu and Tokugawa Ieyasu." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1353633, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1584 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
